result.reason: The operative language fully reaches the stated fallback by requiring Array to maintain USD 1 million in E&O coverage and USD 2 million in cyber/privacy coverage. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits CGL, workers' compensation, and certificates and uses lower E&O and cyber limits. The amendment is substantively minimal and leaves the existing counterparts and language provisions unchanged, but drafting quality is reduced because the new insurance provision is appended without the referenced Section 18.15 number and appears beneath Section 18.14's unrelated heading.
